summary: The agent reread the requirements document and rewrote REQ-011 so an admin can cancel any booking that has not yet ended, including one in progress, while cancelling an ended booking is rejected and users stay blocked from changing a booking once it has started. Check that the new REQ-011 wording matches the intended admin cancellation rule before approving P1 for the next phase.
